entries.title: Psalms 97:1
segments: ¶The LORD reigns; Let the earth rejoice; Let the multitude of isles be glad!

entries.title: Psalms 97:2
segments: Clouds and darkness surround Him; Righteousness and justice [are] the foundation of His throne.

entries.title: Psalms 97:3
segments: A fire goes before Him, And burns up His enemies round about.

entries.title: Psalms 97:4
segments: His lightnings light the world; The earth sees and trembles.

entries.title: Psalms 97:5
segments: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, At the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

entries.title: Psalms 97:6
segments: The heavens declare His righteousness, And all the peoples see His glory.

entries.title: Psalms 97:7
segments: Let all be put to shame who serve carved images, Who boast of idols. Worship Him, all [you] gods.

entries.title: Psalms 97:8
segments: ¶Zion hears and is glad, And the daughters of Judah rejoice Because of Your judgments, O LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 97:9
segments: For You, LORD, [are] most high above all the earth; You are exalted far above all gods.

entries.title: Psalms 97:10
segments: You who love the LORD, hate evil! He preserves the souls of His saints; He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 97:11
segments: Light is sown for the righteous, And gladness for the upright in heart.

entries.title: Psalms 97:12
segments: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous, And give thanks at the remembrance of His holy name.
